programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲:7
programme.desc: 狗狗101新把戲:完美組合.本集節目介紹拉布拉多貴賓巴格犬黃金貴賓吉娃娃臘腸騎士比熊犬和吉娃娃約克夏等數種混種狗混種狗能增加基因多樣性，使狗兒具有較優良的生理特質，例如減少掉毛而適合過敏者飼養，或擁有安定的性格能協助孩子們克服障礙，最適合人類的夥伴

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲:8
programme.desc: 狗狗101新把戲:叫我第一名.什麼狗才能得到第一名的頭銜？是天生的美貌是靠美容師的巧手，還是場上的姿態？今天將介紹這些才華洋溢的狗狗，如優雅的西施犬外觀獨特的牛頭梗忠誠又聰明的喜樂蒂牧羊犬滑稽的日本狆犬等這些狗都是犬展界及狗狗競賽的寵兒，有些仰賴天生的特質，有些仰賴訓練師的啟發因此無論身形大小品種，每種狗都有發光發熱的一面

programme.title: 熊貓總動員:5

programme.title: 家有惡犬第3季:4
programme.desc: 家有惡犬第3季:潑猴生事.在本週的家有惡犬中,我們要帶各位一起看寵物耍猴戲,有為了玩具從天而降的寶寶,也有與貓為伍的小鸚鵡,有到處撒野的捲尾猴,還有會耍特技的小狗接著,我們要帶大家看會啟動警報的寵物,有用特別方式叫主人起床的哈士奇,還有被餓死鬼附身,永遠吃不飽的拉布拉多貴賓然後,我們還要帶大家看罪魁禍首的寵物,有帶頭追逐的狗,以及調皮搗蛋,卻集三千寵愛於一身的貓另外,我們還有多才多藝的寵物,有喜歡翻滾的鬥牛犬,會裝可憐的獵犬,還有會跳舞的中國冠毛犬最後則是賊頭賊腦的寵物,有翻箱倒櫃的貓,偷皮包的狗,還有會趁四下無人,大搞破壞的哈士奇,這些寵物全都有令人髮指的惡劣行徑,卻也受盡主人的寵愛,究竟,本週誰能獲得最後的惡犬之霸冠軍頭銜,成為終極惡犬?

programme.desc: 跟著還是小寶寶的兔寶寶太菲鴉以及其他經典的卡通人物，一 起在老婆婆的屋子內展開奇妙的冒險吧!

programme.title: 金厲害潛水艇
programme.desc: 年輕天真的海豚金厲害帶領一艘裝滿魚兒和海水的另類潛水艇，打算前往他們夢寐以求,具有純淨水源的陸地拉斯維加斯，但這段奇葩的海陸大冒險沿途總是波折不斷，有時內憂有時外患,一點也不平靜

programme.title: 恐龍邦尼的世界-認識邦尼:1013
programme.desc: 主角是一隻友善樂觀的紫色暴龍邦尼，牠和牠的恐龍朋友（如畢巴畢潔）以及人類小孩一起，透過歌唱跳舞和遊戲，學習分享關懷想像和誠實等正向品格與生活技能，提供歡樂與教育價值

programme.title: 恐龍邦尼的世界
programme.desc: 在一起進行的有趣且富有想像的冒險中，邦尼幫助孩子們探索學齡前的強烈情緒，並向他們展示如何愛自己愛他人以及社區

programme.title: 兔巴哥大工程
programme.desc: 兔巴哥大工程由兔巴哥和蘿拉經營的樂樂工程隊，或許施工品質可能有點令人擔憂，但笑料絕對是貨真價實的！鎖定卡通頻道以免錯過任何精彩笑料！

programme.title: 農場雞動隊
programme.desc: 最不像英雄的英雄小隊農場雞動隊 總是在動物們有危難時跳出來神救援小隊由四隻農場動物外加一顆蛋所組成，他們渴望藉由冒險救援跳脫平凡的農場生活，因此每天總是衝鋒陷陣到處幫忙！

programme.title: 超級蝙蝠車
programme.desc: 蝙蝠俠羅賓以及蝙蝠女孩因一起陰謀而離開蝙蝠洞，蝙蝠電腦於是將她的主機板複製到蝙蝠車上，賦予它們生命剛誕生的超級蝙蝠車隨即展開保衛已曝光的蝙蝠洞，及對抗邪惡敵人 the Legion of Zoom!的重大任務

programme.title: 湯姆貓與傑利鼠
programme.desc: 家了來三隻可惡的小貓，弄得家裡天翻地覆，還害得湯姆一直被主人誤會，不僅如此，連傑利也被整了，氣得湯姆與傑利攜手合作，共同對抗這三隻可惡的狠角色！

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go
programme.desc: 少年悍將！GO是2013年卡通頻道和華納製作的卡通電視節目也是DC系列少年悍將漫畫的改編卡通，跟前作不同點在於，本作畫法以萌系畫風呈現，更大的特點是它著重在喜劇效果上，沒有前作的黑暗嚴肅氣氛，劇中多圍繞在少年悍將們的平時生活本做最大的看點是製作組將許多DC的人物做為背景角色呈現

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go
programme.desc: 少年悍將！GO是2013年卡通頻道和華納製作的卡通電視節目也是DC系列少年悍將漫畫的改編卡通，跟前作不同點在於，本作畫法以萌系畫風呈現，更大的特點是它著重在喜劇效果上，沒有前作的黑暗嚴肅氣氛，劇中多圍繞在少年悍將們的平時生活本做最大的看點是製作組將許多DC的人物做為背景角色呈現

programme.title: 探險活寶
programme.desc: 一個呆呆的小男孩阿寶，一條充滿智慧的老狗老皮，他們成了拍檔，一同探索哇賽祕境獨特又有趣的奇幻世界他們彼此相互幫助，度過危險與困境，一起享受歡樂的時光與感動的時刻這種小孩與狗之間無價的友誼及特別的經驗，使得這部卡通更加賞心悅目

programme.title: 難捕
programme.desc: 從實驗室裡逃脫的黏TT橙色生物！可是身為偽裝界變身達人的難捕就像他的名字一樣難捕! 哪有那麼簡單就被捉回去!看來這兩位瘋狂科學家的日子只會更加失控!更加混亂!

programme.title: 阿甘奇幻妙世界
programme.desc: 歡迎回到最奇葩的集集小鎮!在這裡你會發現一切世俗的規定不過是個笑話，而陶家的生活，什麼狀況都有可能發生，不管發生什麼意外都不意外！

programme.title: 愛煩多王子冒險中:8
programme.desc: 前往雄鷹之山的旅程中，愛煩多遇到了一隻變成人的詛咒牛蛙，而解開詛咒的唯一方式就是得到一個吻，不過呢，想到得到王子的親吻可不是一件容易的事

programme.title: 天兵公園-追憶錄影帶
programme.desc: 明明是簡單的工作卻引爆超現實又荒誕的災難! 反正只要有鳥哥和阿天在的地方，不管大事小事普通事都會變成令人難以置信的大混亂，當然也包括惹火老闆及同事給自己找麻煩

programme.title: 豆豆先生
programme.desc: 豆豆先生帶著相機想要捕捉大自然的美態，可是反被大自然捕捉的他感到非常糗也非常生氣!原來是受到野生動物紀錄片的啟發，豆豆先生拿起他塵封已久的老相機出發到郊外想要捕捉完美的野生動物照片,不過瞎忙了兩天卻一點收獲也沒有,最後還發現自己竟然才是被捕捉的對象！

programme.desc: 這是一部超適合全家觀賞的冒險幽默喜劇充滿熱情搞笑的原創力和想像力！故事描述三隻熊熊兄弟大大胖達阿極非常積極想融入人類的世界，但又頻頻凸槌個性完全不同的三隻熊感情超好！大大樂觀外向很敢衝胖達感情豐富愛幻想阿極特立獨行超特別由於他們愛玩手機夢想在網路爆紅也常鬧出不少笑話，這讓故事時時充滿驚喜！

programme.desc: 年輕天真的海豚金厲害帶領一艘裝滿魚兒和海水的另類潛水艇，打算前往他們夢寐以求,具有純淨水源的陸地拉斯維加斯，但這段奇葩的海陸大冒險沿途總是波折不斷，有時內憂有時外患,一點也不平靜

programme.title: 豆豆先生
programme.desc: 豆豆先生帶著相機想要捕捉大自然的美態，可是反被大自然捕捉的他感到非常糗也非常生氣!原來是受到野生動物紀錄片的啟發，豆豆先生拿起他塵封已久的老相機出發到郊外想要捕捉完美的野生動物照片,不過瞎忙了兩天卻一點收獲也沒有,最後還發現自己竟然才是被捕捉的對象！

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go
programme.desc: 少年悍將！GO是2013年卡通頻道和華納製作的卡通電視節目也是DC系列少年悍將漫畫的改編卡通，跟前作不同點在於，本作畫法以萌系畫風呈現，更大的特點是它著重在喜劇效果上，沒有前作的黑暗嚴肅氣氛，劇中多圍繞在少年悍將們的平時生活本做最大的看點是製作組將許多DC的人物做為背景角色呈現

programme.title: 怪盜喬克
programme.desc: 主人公的怪盜JOKER與助手小八一起，不僅要從警察妨礙中逃出生天，還要與怪盜斯佩德女怪盜鑽石女王鬥智鬥勇下，一次次將寶物成功盜走

programme.title: 超級小白:21
programme.desc: 野原小白，一隻看起來不能再平凡的小狗其實是隻超能狗平日就在維持和平的小白在帶上超能S章後就會自信爆棚他，只有一個目標，就是保護傳說中的Bobobobobone，聽說誰得到它就能統治世界

programme.title: 農場雞動隊
programme.desc: 最不像英雄的英雄小隊農場雞動隊 總是在動物們有危難時跳出來神救援小隊由四隻農場動物外加一顆蛋所組成，他們渴望藉由冒險救援跳脫平凡的農場生活，因此每天總是衝鋒陷陣到處幫忙！

programme.title: 難捕
programme.desc: 從實驗室裡逃脫的黏TT橙色生物！可是身為偽裝界變身達人的難捕就像他的名字一樣難捕! 哪有那麼簡單就被捉回去!看來這兩位瘋狂科學家的日子只會更加失控!更加混亂!

programme.title: 搖滾吧！寶貝
programme.desc: 一個超酷的寶寶樂團，即便受到討厭音樂的托兒所保母密切監督，這些音樂控寶貝們仍持續他們充滿歡樂與節奏的冒險， 快和娃娃飛仔 米呦卡羅斯與他們快抓狂的保母朵朵開一起隨著音樂大力搖擺！

programme.title: Totally Spies! 嗆辣特工
programme.desc: 三個來自比弗利山莊的好姊妹，她們每天周旋於普通的高中生活與詭秘莫測的國際間諜活動中！

programme.title: 機甲猛鬥:2
programme.desc: 機甲猛鬥劇情描述一名心善且滿腦子天馬行空創造力的小男孩孟鬥，偶然發現一艘監禁運送著許多反派機器人的宇宙監獄飛船墜毀在地球上，並且結識了其中一台名為機甲球的機器人機甲球具備能將物品機甲化，使其具備高科技的能力，而在孟鬥成功馴服機甲球並成為它的主人後，一人一機決定成為搭檔，攜手追捕其餘在逃的機器罪犯們

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版

programme.desc: 高中校園出現槍擊案，三個選項，逃跑躲藏與正面對決，你選擇哪一個？！高中生柔伊自從母親去世後，性情大變，也與前美軍狙擊手的父親關係緊張某日，同學路易斯載她上學途中，她目睹同學克里斯與崔斯坦等人在田野放置惡作劇的裝置，當她不慎在學生餐廳打翻飲料至女廁清洗時，一輛廂型車衝進餐廳並射殺學生，主謀的崔斯坦要求倖存的學生開直播，渴望藉此受到社會關注，並對之前受到的霸凌反擊面對學生殺戮校園的恐怖攻擊，柔伊將要如何逃出險境，拯救無辜呢？！

programme.title: 巴爾幹防線
programme.desc: 面對無情戰火，他們堅守崗位！1999年，北約未經聯合國認可，對南斯拉夫展開空襲，俄羅斯軍官貝克臨危受命，要在英國軍隊之前，掌控科索沃的普利斯提納機場，直到增援部隊抵達為了對抗阿爾巴尼亞的激進分子，貝克要求已被除役的昔日同袍加入小隊這時，當年害同袍被除役的沙塔洛夫，為替友人復仇，與貝克在機場不期而遇，隨後加入陣容面對敵眾我寡的局勢，貝克將如何帶領小隊死守機場呢？！

programme.title: 移動迷宮-死亡解藥
programme.desc: 黑暗陰謀即將揭曉，他們將用自由與熱血，終結這場慘無人道的末日實驗為了拯救被組織擄走的生死摯友民豪，湯瑪士離開安全庇護所，率領幽地戰士重返起點湯瑪士帶著復仇與拯救的怒火闖入，與昔日戀人陣營對立在對與錯的灰色地帶，究竟誰才是真正的救世主呢？！

programme.title: 龍吻
programme.desc: 李連杰飾演一名來自中國的警察來到法國巴黎，偕同法國警方保護中國政府官員生命安全，但是他居然發現法國警方才是加害中國官員的幕後黑手法國的警察將中國官員全部殺害，而李連杰手中握有一卷整個事發過程的錄影帶，於是遭到法國警方的追殺

programme.title: 俠盜聯盟
programme.desc: 偷走的是寶物，偷不走的是恩怨神偷張丹出獄後，為了洗刷當年冤屈，不惜重組軍團鋌而走險他攜手百變女神葉紅科技宅男陳小寶，神偷三人組遠赴歐洲古堡，驚天盜取稀世珍寶命運之翼當法國警探死命追捕昔日師父暗藏殺機，這場跨國奪寶棋局，誰才是最後贏家呢？！

programme.title: 致命救援
programme.desc: 無人相信的證詞，永不放棄的追擊，這次，她從受害者化身為獵人！吉兒曾從一名連環殺手的地洞中驚險逃脫，但警方因找不到證據且質疑其精神狀況，始終不予採信一年後，吉兒的妹妹茉莉離奇失蹤，吉兒深信是當年的殺手捲土重來在警方拒絕搜救的情況下，她決定隻身深入險境，在太陽下山前爭分奪秒與夢魘搏鬥，揭開被世人視為幻覺的殘酷真相

programme.title: 人工進化

programme.title: 一字千金:19

programme.title: 搖曳露營3
programme.desc: 第三季著重於獨旅與團體露營體驗於山梨靜岡等地展開富士山露營庭院露營賞櫻露營雨天露營穿梭吊橋之國體驗峭壁上的溫泉主角志摩凜騎著摩托車挑戰多座水壩與祕境吊橋，並在湖邊露營場與貓咪互動，享用熱騰騰的番茄義大利麵撫子則體驗單人小露營，品嚐水壩咖哩飯與生火腿奶油乳酪餅野外活動同好會的千明葵惠那前往山區露營，不僅傳承了領柴劈柴的社團傳統，葵更獲得了公路自行車女孩們最後圍繞著溫暖的篝火，品嚐蕎麥麵與墨西哥薄餅，笑談形狀像雞肉料理的富士雞五湖，期待更多露營時光

programme.title: 少年願望事務所
programme.desc: 少年願望事務所節目深入探討當代青少年所面對的親子關係金錢觀兩性問題與同儕互動等現實課題，並以輕鬆幽默的方式呈現，讓觀眾在討論嚴肅議題之餘，也能開懷一笑

programme.title: 鹹魚小隊
programme.desc: 俄烏戰爭的爆發，殘酷的說明國際情勢的瞬息萬變無論臺灣是否會遭遇戰爭，大朋友小朋友都應該學習防災知識與相關技能，以提升社會面對災難的韌性公視兒少科普實境節目－鹹魚小隊，由LIS情境科學教材的創辦人鹽八（嚴天浩），以及知名登山家義消山域搜救隊隊長三條魚（詹喬愉）主持兩人將以自身專業，以輕鬆有趣的風格，帶領青少年了解災難，進而勇於面對災難參與的青少年，將挑戰一系列製作單位以戰爭災難為藍圖設計的任務兩位主持人和專家，會透過科學實驗和救難演練，協助青少年習得挑戰任務所需要的知識與技能至於最後能否順利完成任務，就看青少年們的本事啦！

programme.title: 歡迎光臨我的牧場
programme.desc: 歡迎光臨我的牧場從牧場小主人的視角，紀錄台灣 13 種不一樣的牧場生活！包括豬羊鹿馬，甚至少見的青蛙和鱷魚養殖場等，帶大家認識養育動物的基本知識看見在牧場長大的孩子，展現對自然與動物的喜愛，也熱情分享飼養心得

programme.title: 搖曳露營3
programme.desc: 第三季著重於獨旅與團體露營體驗於山梨靜岡等地展開富士山露營庭院露營賞櫻露營雨天露營穿梭吊橋之國體驗峭壁上的溫泉主角志摩凜騎著摩托車挑戰多座水壩與祕境吊橋，並在湖邊露營場與貓咪互動，享用熱騰騰的番茄義大利麵撫子則體驗單人小露營，品嚐水壩咖哩飯與生火腿奶油乳酪餅野外活動同好會的千明葵惠那前往山區露營，不僅傳承了領柴劈柴的社團傳統，葵更獲得了公路自行車女孩們最後圍繞著溫暖的篝火，品嚐蕎麥麵與墨西哥薄餅，笑談形狀像雞肉料理的富士雞五湖，期待更多露營時光

programme.title: 成仁高中偵探社2
programme.desc: 第二季的開始，會?辦公桌下的監聽器亮了一下，離開總會後，見學長收到會長的訊息，偵探總會多名偵探遭到暗殺，組織被盯上了，剛剛那樣講是為了降低敵?戒?這學期起，?學?不能再正?光明經營偵探社，必須私下練兵，秘密為總會挑選菁英?中?..

programme.title: 蒙古游牧人生
programme.desc: 本系列紀錄片深入介紹三個蒙古遊牧民族-蒙古族查坦族和哈薩克族，他們的日常生活與動物的關係，以及面臨傳統生活方式改變的認同危機

programme.title: 台灣囡仔讚！
programme.desc: 全新一季台灣囡仔，讚!，由潘君侖與姵君姊姊共同主持，帶領觀眾走訪校園第一線，體驗多元豐富的課程，幫助大家全面的認識現代教學思維的學習情況，透過每所獨一無二的展現舞台，讓同學們發聲，介紹自己就讀的學校特色，帶我們一起上山下海認識全國的臺灣囡仔

programme.title: 富貴門
programme.desc: 沙富來羅嘉良父母早亡，貧困交加中把弟弟沙寶來馬國明帶大；為生存在馬來西亞當老千機緣巧合下，他盜用了卓祟禧私生子卓一鳴的身份，與視他為親弟弟的大哥卓一元呂良偉回到香港進入卓家，搖身一變成為豪門二少爺然而在他未冒認身分之前，曾邂逅卓家千金卓一心袁詠儀，並兩人互生情愫，這短暫的浪漫，讓卓一心痛苦不堪，即欲斬斷這假不倫戀卓家上下從未懷?沙富來身分，極力想補償這個受苦多年的兒子，讓沙富來得到他本來失落的家庭溫暖，也讓他享受著金錢和權力的巨大誘惑，漸漸陷入貪婪恐懼嫉妒的人性試煉...

programme.title: 健康好生活

programme.desc: 將一生奉獻給家人的李孝心，本是田徑的明日之星，因代替拋家棄子的父親扛下養家重擔只好輟學孝心要照顧媽媽兩個哥哥和一個弟弟，她在江南的健身中心工作，每天一大早就開始為家人的生活奔走，不僅要做體力活，還得應付各種情緒，長期下來令她疲憊不堪這天，孝心決定自立門戶追求屬於自己的幸福生活，而家人們也該各自學習獨立了?

programme.title: 桃花映江山
programme.desc: 北苑國公主姜桃花（孟子義 飾）千里迢迢來到大祈和親，卻慘遭設局陷害清白盡毀為了在危機四伏的異國苟活，桃花將錯就錯，嫁給了權傾朝野習慣獨行的冷酷左相沈在野（劉學義 飾），憑著一流的逢場作戲本領與極強的求生欲，展開驚心動魄的生存戰

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 是一部講述大企業天王食品會長家的獨生女吳若拉對完美挑剔男的小說家黃馬馬一見鍾情，描述吳若拉家族和黃馬馬家族之間所發生的事情的電視劇

programme.title: 世上最漂亮的女兒
programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子（金海淑 飾），含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善（裕善 飾）是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉（金素妍 飾）是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱（洪宗玄 飾）後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧（金荷景 飾）曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 魔鬼剋星-冰天凍地
programme.desc: 史賓格勒一家在這集中，回到魔鬼剋星的發源地-前紐約消防局大樓，與第一代的隊員重逢，並期望最高機密的研究室能夠研發出更先進的抓鬼技術不過此時卻發現神秘的寒慄死神躲藏在數百年前的古老文物中被釋放了強大的寒冰能力將造成地球迎來第二次的冰河時期，並且釋放出關在研究室中的厲鬼們，魔鬼剋星必須團結一心聯手保護家園並且阻止世界末日的來臨

programme.title: 秘境探險
programme.desc: 故事講述年輕時期的奈森德瑞克（湯姆霍蘭德 飾）與夥伴蘇利（馬克華伯格 飾 ）的第一場尋寶冒險故事，他們兩人將歷經跨國危險和挑戰去尋找從未被發現的巨大寶藏，並從中找尋奈森失聯已久的哥哥導演魯賓弗來舍表示：我們實地去了巴塞隆納的松之聖母瑪莉亞教堂取景拍攝，那是一座十五世紀的歌德式大教堂，也是電影中實際發生的地點和場景

programme.title: 驚奇隊長
programme.desc: 原是空軍飛行員的卡蘿丹佛斯，在克里星球甦醒並失去了過往所有的記憶，她獲得驚人的超人力量，受軍隊的最高指揮官與導師揚羅格裘德洛 飾演指導，以克里人的身分戰鬥，與菁英軍事單位星際部隊成員共同對抗史克魯人的侵略；不過在最新的任務中，她為了抵抗外星入侵，意外到訪C-53星球的地球，與神盾局長尼克福瑞一起聯手尋找羅森博士的下落片中除了神盾局人員及局長不變定律山繆傑克森外，還多了許多新鮮面孔，如裘德洛陳靜（代表作品瘋狂亞洲富豪）和安妮特班寧，還有一隻非常有哏的橘貓

programme.title: 28年毀滅倒數
programme.desc: 自從致命的病毒從化學武器實驗室流出後，至今已經過了28年，在仍舊嚴格的隔離政策下，人類漸漸找到與感染者共存的生存方式其中一群生還者，生活在一座有戒備森嚴單一出入口的離島，但是當他們被迫離開家園深入黑暗的外界時，將發現令感染者和生還者突變的駭人秘密

programme.title: 6號鬼病床

programme.title: 寒戰
programme.desc: 報案中心接到匿名電話，衝鋒車被脅持，其中一位警員是現任副處長李文彬獨子鷹派李文彬與警長劉傑輝，危急時刻，二虎相爭李文彬指揮營救，行動代號寒戰然而歹徒對警隊內部瞭如指掌，行動無功而返?人推舉劉傑輝接手劉傑輝答應交予歹徒贖金，卻在過程中發生意外，香港警隊陷入前所未有的威脅

programme.title: 叱咤風雲
programme.desc: 曾經叱吒風雲的LIONS車隊在領隊老申過世後逐漸走向沒落，不願退休的車王李一飛面對新搭檔聯盟歷史上第一個女車手莉莉，他們倆互不相讓，為車隊帶來危機

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之英雄有夢
programme.desc: 故事上較著墨於黃飛鴻成為宗師前的惡戰與歷煉，頗有前傳意味1868年的清末，朝廷腐敗讓人民生活備受煎熬在廣州，黑虎幫和北海幫子兩大惡勢力橫行於黃埔港他們以暴力威脅統治在港口的窮苦人民，讓他們生活在水深火熱之中外界在看來，黃埔港是個繁榮並充滿機會地方，但深入其中，會發現這裡其實是人間煉獄黑虎幫的老闆雷公因一個新兵手下阿飛，以過人身手及膽識直取北海幫子首領的頭腦，而讓黑虎幫獨霸一方，不但靠鴉片賺進大筆銀兩，更進行著卑鄙的販賣人口勾當，雷公更視阿飛如己出其實，阿飛背後另有故事，心中更另有計畫他和肝膽相照的朋友們設了陷阱，救下窮苦的人們，更公開與雷公進行生死決鬥

programme.title: FIGHTING！女孩們
programme.desc: 描述1999年住在巨濟島的高中女孩必善對嘻哈舞蹈瘋狂著迷，她人生的唯一夢想便是前往首爾，成?嚴正化的伴舞，為了獲得師長認可，好在校內擁有屬於自己的舞蹈練習室，她跟好友美娜說服當過啦啦隊隊長的轉學生世賢，一起組成啦啦隊社團千禧年女孩，她們跑遍家鄉各處，用熱情舞蹈?居民應援，也累積了深厚友誼，但接踵而來的難題，令女孩們面臨考驗，必善的青梅竹馬植行則是一路默默地陪在她身旁為她打氣，在末日預言不斷充滿不確定性的世紀末裡，寫下最閃耀動人的青春篇章

programme.title: 七龍珠超-布羅利
programme.desc: 七龍珠超：布羅利為劇場系列第20部作品，上映三日大破10億日圓票房，寫下該系列電影有史以來，票房累積成長速度最快的紀錄，更將火力集中在悟空與布羅利之間布羅利在這次片中佔有非常關鍵的角色，身為少數仍倖存的賽亞人，神秘的布羅利，連悟空與貝吉達都從未謀面，但在新片裡，悟空等三位走上不同發展的賽亞人將相遇對決，也成為七龍珠系列粉絲們最關注的故事發展！

programme.title: 航海王:1091
programme.desc: 偉大航路的黃金梅利號阿拉巴斯坦的王女．薇薇也在船上被稱為沙漠之國的阿拉巴斯坦王國，從以前就一直被不降雨的異常氣像所困擾，為人民著想的國王．寇布拉身邊，人人和平的生活著但是距今兩年前，雨變得只落在國王所居住的城市裡，同時間，世界政府禁止製造持有的人工降雨粉．跳舞粉也運往國王的身邊這事件成為國王與人民分裂的開端相信身為父親也是國王．寇布拉的薇薇，為了要把引起這異常氣像並陷害國王的邪惡組織的身分曝光而離開她的國家而現在為了阻止萬惡根源卻是國家英雄的克洛克達爾，薇薇和魯夫等夥伴一同前往阿拉巴斯坦為了奪回被奪走的重要東西而奔走！

programme.title: 男生女生
programme.desc: 阿武吳奇隆是一名替身演員，與聰明伶俐的女演員琪琪徐若瑄成了好朋友阿武暗戀小琪，但因為過於勞累在片場昏倒，阿武醒來後發現自己身在醫院，他已經昏睡了一個星期了，夢中發生的一切，卻都已實現了

programme.title: 極速引爆
programme.desc: 故事敘述某天當銀行分行經理成圭上班前開車載著孩子們去學校的途中，突然接到一通未知來電，對方表示若他離開位子，便會引爆炸彈認為這只是通詐騙電話的成圭，卻隨即目擊某名同事被以同樣的方式對待，那輛車就在他眼前爆炸同時，成圭還被懷疑是釜山恐怖攻擊事件的嫌犯，遭警方追捕下車的話車子就會瞬間爆炸，在被警方追擊的過程中，還無法中斷與未知來電者的通話，成圭與孩子們能否從這場危機中脫險呢？

programme.title: 阿飛與阿基
programme.desc: 阿飛和阿基是一對患難兄弟，從小一齊長大一塊混江湖，情義深重的生死之交阿飛與阿基天生命硬，他們追隨過的黑幫老大，都被他們剋死，所以街坊鄰居都不願與他們接近，而其它黑社會組織更不歡迎他們加入，因此他們想要起另起爐灶，合伙創立黑幫

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: 任老爺之父任老太爺下葬二十年後，任老爺依照當時下葬時的風水師建議起棺遷葬，茅山師父九叔受任老爺所託處理事宜，惟起棺後，大家發現任老太爺下葬二十年後，毫無腐化跡象，九叔建議火化不果，於是把棺木寄放在義莊

programme.title: 逃學威龍
programme.desc: 周星星是皇家香港警察特別任務連某隊隊長，受上司委派假扮學生混入一間中學當臥底, 搜尋一支失槍的下落警隊同僚曹達華亦假扮工友潛伏在該校接應周星星其間周星星因受不了中學生活，在意圖逃學的過程中遇見了好心關心他的該校女教師何敏，周星星愛上何敏並因此發憤圖強用功讀書，兩人歷經種種誤會，周星星最後成功搗破了大飛的犯罪圖謀, 並抱得美人歸

programme.title: 超級天兵之機車班長
programme.desc: 任務結束，警方高層與憲兵司令部展開磋商檢討，對犯罪集團日益國際化及專業化的趨勢頗感憂心，為提升協調合作能力，打擊犯罪，乃決定仿憲兵原有編製成立一支由憲兵部隊及警察菁英共同組織的反報特勤隊，代號夜鷹

programme.title: 劌心劍
programme.desc: 洪武年間（即西元1368-1398年），錦衣衛丁武和蔣瑍奉旨查探一起重大貪腐案丁武和蔣瑍是錦衣衛內一對親如兄弟的小旗官，一個家有懷孕的老婆，苦於生計；一個愛上了青樓女子，需錢贖身兩人拼盡全力破案，為了愛人為了兄弟為了幸福，誓要建立大功改善現狀但兄弟二人屢屢受挫，線索接連中斷幕後黑手似乎早有準備，錦衣衛內藏有眼線眼看立功無望，急於救愛人的蔣瑍決定以身犯險，丁武逐漸與兄弟反目

programme.title: 河神-詭水怪談
programme.desc: 故事講述了天津衛五河撈屍隊的水上警察郭得友與師弟丁卯在酒肉和尚李大愣的慫恿下一同探查三岔河口沉屍案，經歷了魏家墳探鬼樓陰陽河仙指路惡狗村捉妖，最終抓住幕後真兇的故事

programme.title: 還錢
programme.desc: 由張博駿（陳柏霖 飾）率領的竊盜集團，在小年夜悄悄執行了史上最大金額 10 億元竊盜案，沒想到卻遇上黑吃黑，意外讓首腦張博駿的前女友沈舒玟（蔡思? 飾）捲入案件，逼得他們必須把 10 億元原封不動還回去，但是搶錢容易還錢難，他們將如何出神入化地完成這個不可能的任務

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: 茅山師父九叔受委託為任老爺起棺遷葬，惟任老爺之屍體屍變，變成殭屍，並四處為害此時，九叔的兩名徒弟文才及秋生亦分別因女友婷婷而被殭屍所傷，以及受女鬼小玉所迷惑九叔如何同時面對徒弟們生死存亡，以及殭屍為害的問題呢？

programme.title: 夏日的檸檬草
programme.desc: 開學的那一天，曉夏和柚子在教室裡大打出手，紛亂中一個少年逆光從七彩的粉筆灰中走來如果說，每個男孩心中都有一個女神沈佳宜；那麼，每個女孩心中就有一個王子班長，那就是程奕初見面就對程奕一見鐘情，曉夏的女追男之路就此展開，她標新立異的追求方式讓朋友們都捏了把冷汗，柚子更是不以為然，但，程奕該不會就吃這一套吧？

programme.title: 新龍門客棧之英雄覺醒
programme.desc: 東海將領周淮安護孤女曲靈來到龍門島上的龍門客棧，客棧中暗流湧動，東西兩廠輪番上陣，掌櫃金鑲玉百般試探，周淮安深感此行目的愈發撲朔迷離，龍門島世代血咒驚現仙藥之迷，東廠馮督主為謀得仙藥殺害曲靈，周淮安會為家族榮耀順從馮督主還是秉持內心正義奮起反抗？一場正義與邪惡的生死較量就此展開

programme.title: 哪吒之魔童降世
programme.desc: 元始天尊將混元珠提煉成靈珠和魔丸，本應是靈珠轉世的哪吒因為太乙真人的失誤被魔丸托生，生來便註定是混世魔王在太乙真人的幫助下，希望哪吒可以學習本領，為民除害期間，哪吒認識了龍王之子敖丙，成為了彼此各自唯一的朋友然而面對人們的誤解和天雷的降臨，哪吒是否命中注定會立地成魔？他將何去何從？

programme.title: 乒乓男孩
programme.desc: 熱愛桌球的胡冠宇和好友黃軒夢想成為全世界最強的雙打組合，儘管學校社團資源有限，他們仍樂在其中，為夢想努力不懈直到一次雙打比賽落敗黃軒被嚴厲的母親要求轉學，兩人帶著心結分道揚鑣一年後的國手選拔賽上他們在球桌兩端相遇；即將一決勝負，面對自己最有默契的搭檔，誰能脫穎而出成為選手？

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山間，一僧一道比鄰而居和尚隨和開朗，更有一女徒菁菁玲瓏可愛；道士古板嚴厲，而徒弟嘉樂卻鬼馬頑皮性格不同的兩個師傅口角不斷，大斗其法，兩個冤家徒弟也搞笑連連，笑料頻出某天，一支奇異的喪葬隊伍路過此地，某邊疆皇族中屍毒死去，幻化成殭屍，千鶴道長及王子護送棺木上京途中遭遇暴雨，棺木被雷劈開，殭屍破棺而出，大開殺戒烏侍郎攜王子僥倖逃命，但王子已中屍毒和尚與道士命徒兒照看王子，兩人則衝入樹林尋找千鶴道長

programme.title: 周處除三害
programme.desc: 劇情描述通緝犯陳桂林（阮經天 飾）在角頭大哥告別式上囂張尋仇，卻發現自己竟然只是排名第三的通緝犯，於是他查出前兩名通緝犯的下落，要將他們一一除掉

programme.title: 查無此心
programme.desc: 一年前，第二分局偵查隊副隊長吳潔在賭場外守了一整夜，但到頭來一無所獲不久之後，她接到了心碎的消息：她的丈夫，同為隊裡的同仁，因憂鬱症在車內舉槍自盡遺書上寫著對不起！吳潔弄髒你的車...

programme.title: 愛上花豹女
programme.desc: 我只要看到女人的酥胸，就會流鼻血我有病，對不對？25歲的強尼向心理諮商師馬克訴說著自己的苦惱 強尼在好朋友王子與公主開的烘焙教室工作，他嚮往著家的幸福，也捨不得三個月後要離開他的好友，飛去義大利學烘焙當強尼見到臨時找來烘焙教室教學的烘焙達人瑪莉後......他的人生就此轉彎 離婚多年的瑪莉感受到強尼帶給她的感覺，卻因年齡的差距而猶豫不已，好友孟潔鼓勵瑪莉勇敢的一口將小鮮肉吃下去王子再三警告強尼，像瑪莉這種熟女愛嫩男的花豹女，要是冷不防伸出爪子來，可是會像花豹一樣抓花男人的臉但強尼已下定決心，他要追求屬於他的幸福

programme.title: 長歌行:7
programme.desc: 原是永寧郡主的李長歌因玄武門之變父喪母亡，她僥倖逃出城，赴幽州求援；途中，偶遇化名秦准的草原部落特勤阿詩勒隼，兩人不打不相識，漸生英雄相惜之感長歌在幽州粉碎一場陰謀，但郡主的身份卻敗露，前往?州避禍長歌藏於?州太守公孫恆身邊，助其共抗草原勢力侵襲，卻未想到敵方將領阿詩勒隼竟是自己的舊識秦准

programme.title: 號角響起
programme.desc: 一部具有顛覆傳統意味的軍教片佳作，吳念真的劇本將已成老套和公式化的軍中故事，改變成四個年紀相仿的有個性的年輕人之間不打不相識的友情故事，在歡樂中滲入了不少頗富時代感的現實嘲諷，教人產生不少會心微笑主演的金城武林志穎和小虎隊兩名成員吳奇隆蘇有朋，除了偶像魅力之外也頗能容入角色之中，其中以林志穎飾演的小廟公是有新鮮感和趣味性，導演朱廷平在本片不玩低級趣味，卻自然散發一種歡樂的逗笑氣氛

programme.title: 龍眾舞
programme.desc: 年邁的龍媽媽，終生的心願就是希望能抱抱孫子，享受當祖母的樂趣每逢春節，龍媽媽必定許下這心願，一心期望家中的3個子女能為龍家添兒育女

programme.title: 開心鬼
programme.desc: 朱秀才連考十多次也未中狀元，老父因此氣得病逝，老婆也離他而去，無奈之下朱在一座廟裡懸樑自盡，不料心中有冤屈，無法投胎轉世，靈魂只有附在自盡那條麻繩上 八十年代，高中學生林青青林小花及顏如玉在假期旅行中為避暴風雨，誤闖進古廟，青在忙亂中將麻繩帶回宿舍，靈魂附在麻繩上的朱也跟被帶進學校，鬧出不少笑話朱與她們成了好朋友，並規勸她們要靠自己的能力去創造未來，而朱亦因此沉冤得雪，投胎轉世

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山間，一僧一道比鄰而居和尚隨和開朗，更有一女徒菁菁玲瓏可愛；道士古板嚴厲，而徒弟嘉樂卻鬼馬頑皮性格不同的兩個師傅口角不斷，大斗其法，兩個冤家徒弟也搞笑連連，笑料頻出某天，一支奇異的喪葬隊伍路過此地，某邊疆皇族中屍毒死去，幻化成殭屍，千鶴道長及王子護送棺木上京途中遭遇暴雨，棺木被雷劈開，殭屍破棺而出，大開殺戒烏侍郎攜王子僥倖逃命，但王子已中屍毒和尚與道士命徒兒照看王子，兩人則衝入樹林尋找千鶴道長

programme.title: 忠烈楊家將
programme.desc: 楊家老么失手打死國舅潘豹，國丈潘仁美懷恨在心北方狼煙四起，楊家之主楊令公擔任先鋒潘仁美任主帥迎擊遼兵楊令公被遼兵圍困時，潘仁美見死不救，身受箭傷的楊令公只能孤守兩狼山楊家七子在母親佘太君的安排下突破遼兵包圍營救父親，卻中了遼兵主帥的詭計，然而兵援遲遲不到，楊家眾人該如何全身而退？

programme.title: 行運超人
programme.desc: 葉孤紅（楊千嬅）自小霉運不斷，為了改運，她找上香港著名風水師賴料布（梁朝偉）料布與孤紅兩人投緣，但賴家確有祖宗遺訓禁止與葉姓人士接近，令料布不敢與孤紅更近一步經過孤紅的努力，料布終於決心突破心防接受孤紅此時料布發現原來孤紅的霉運是玄學高手斷蟹（鄭中基）的從中作梗

programme.title: 新龍門客棧:48
programme.desc: 明朝後期，內憂外患，東有倭寇侵擾，西有異族覬覦沉迷于煉丹修道的老皇上迫於百官壓力，決定立皇長子賢王為太子，並宣召賢王的岳父鎮守西北的老英王前來參加冊立大典這引起強烈渴求儲君之位的皇四子敬王及其政治盟友東廠大太監曹少欽的不滿，暗中策劃陰謀...

programme.title: 碧血劍:1
programme.desc: 夏雪宜?綽號金蛇郎君，全家被溫家堡之惡人慘殺，誓要報仇遇上溫儀後被儀的純真與善良打動，結成愛侶可惜溫儀被溫家堡利用，令雪宜身中劇毒及被挑斷手筋腳筋，儀欲將溫家惡行公開而遭活埋井下亡在生死關頭，雪宜被何紅藥救走並逼婚，結果被打斷雙腳，秘密囚於五毒教的靈蛇洞內 袁承誌?袁崇煥之子，立誌長大後保衛國家父被曹化淳誣害慘死，並誅連九族，承誌被夏雪宜所救，隨後在華山學藝，誓報父仇

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記:49
programme.desc: 故事主要圍繞著武當派張翠山與明教殷素素之子張無忌（由曾舜晞飾演）的成長歷程，講述了江湖上各大門派的恩怨情仇，以及張無忌與峨眉派周芷若元朝郡主趙敏之間的複雜愛情糾葛

programme.desc: 香港在繁榮的背後，同時也是罪惡的溫床蔣天生領導的洪興社是較活躍的社團，駱駝的東英社也蠢蠢欲動，其中東英雙虎烏鴉和笑面虎更是兇殘暴暴戾笑面虎用計在陳酒吧對面開卡拉OK，並請洪興社的基當看場，正式威脅陳，而烏鴉的挑釁引起蔣的不滿，蔣天生與駱駝談判，駱警告烏，烏不忿蔣天生同女伴（一影視女星）陳歐遊烏鴉和笑面虎派殺手伏擊蔣天生劫擄女星，並嫁禍陳

programme.title: 另一種注目
programme.desc: 另一種注目是一個具文化精神的紀實節目，從各種人物故事切入，以嶄新的視野與獨特的觀點，探索台灣社會文化的現象與脈絡，為這個時代留下紀錄

programme.title: 風味轉身
programme.desc: 有故事的台灣物產有故事的台灣農漁人，以及熱愛土地的知名料理人，共同挑戰一場風味轉身的旅程節目走訪台灣山林與海洋，從產地到餐桌，帶領觀眾探索台灣物產的前世今生，深入農漁現場，貼近生產者的日常與堅持，聆聽土地孕育出的動人故事每一集將同時邀請知名主廚以獨特的料理視角重新詮釋在地食材，將產地面臨的挑戰化為創新的風味，讓每一道料理不只是美味，更承載土地人情與永續的價值，完成一場從產地到餐桌的精彩風味轉身

programme.title: 翻生武林:8
programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.title: 踩過界2:22
programme.desc: 綽號盲俠的失明大律師文申俠（王浩信飾）擁有超強的四感，他聯同女師爺趙正妹（蔡思貝飾）私家偵探谷一夏（張振朗飾）為弱勢社群爭取公義，不惜採取踩界手法大律師邵美娜（張曦雯飾）主動接近申俠，二人及後會於法庭對壘，在美娜背後支援的還有其師父簡紹宏（秦沛飾） 申俠於多年前的實習期曾拜紹宏為師，期間卻因一宗無屍命案而師徒決裂；申俠提出新證據為被告上訴，與紹宏再次交鋒，引發連場惡鬥！美娜的出現，同時亦令申俠正妹一夏這個鐵三角組合的關係，產生微妙變化

programme.desc: 1979年冬天，在機械廠保衛科工作的王憲平，深夜巡邏時抓住了一個年紀不大的小偷憲平本準備將其送去派出所，卻被保衛科同事楊大山攔下，大山只將小偷揍了一頓以示教育，便將其放走轉業軍人出身的王憲平，回到家跟媳婦劉淑霞丈母娘那人和，好一通抱怨混混出身的楊大山的所作所為

programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Taos real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly Iron Fist technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her familys objection, so Hongs maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Two Con Men

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qis guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sisters death, but is shocked to discover that her fianc, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jins mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Enchantress

Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu Mok Siu-chung is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit Wei Chiu-hua is killing swordsmen, hes in for more than he bargains for... Its

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The films action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar The Lizard sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich mans party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chiefs granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her fathers towering debt from gambling. programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandoras Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kongs Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee aka. Li Hsiu-hsien as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid

programme.title: 溏心风暴3 Heart And Greed
programme.desc: 凌丽荧李司棋与丈夫黄永正夏雨凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风黄宗泽更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟李国麟助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华关菊英及亲弟梁赞阮兆祥大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧米雪有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家王浩信与许家独生女许贝儿岑丽香相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱陈敏之与有妇之夫郑立安唐文龙的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文黄翠如关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴.

programme.title: 赤沙印记 四叶草.2 Sunshine Heartbeat
programme.desc: 沙滩上，少年十五二十时；他们抛汗， 他们随入情网叶菁杨婉仪叶蕙李思欣及叶茵陈自琦三姊妹小时侯 碰到一个古上贼女郎部容衢儿，女郎预言大家姐将在十八岁那年，遇见身上有四叶草胎记的真命天子转眼间三姊妹已长大，现在是清岚国际学校的中六生清岚沙滩排球队的队长干逸臣司徒瑞祈外表俊朗性格活泼，是校内的风头人物，很多女同学也为了他而加入沙滩排球队，犹如行星屋绕太阳一般一日，三姊妹分别在不同的角度看见臣身上有一个近似四叶草形状的胎记，跟小时侯听到的预言吻合，但菁为人优柔寡断没有主见，菁与茵因因此抛身而出，为制造机会给姐姐而不断奔走不久，三姊妹亦加入了沙滩排球队她们觉得的是，她们竟又在校内的垒学士方上发现四叶草胎记！三姊妹顿感迷闷，不知道吉卜赛女郎所言的真命天子究竟是谁.

programme.desc: 沙滩上，少年十五二十时；他们抛汗， 他们随入情网叶菁杨婉仪叶蕙李思欣及叶茵陈自琦三姊妹小时侯 碰到一个古上贼女郎部容衢儿，女郎预言大家姐将在十八岁那年，遇见身上有四叶草胎记的真命天子转眼间三姊妹已长大，现在是清岚国际学校的中六生清岚沙滩排球队的队长干逸臣司徒瑞祈外表俊朗性格活泼，是校内的风头人物，很多女同学也为了他而加入沙滩排球队，犹如行星屋绕太阳一般一日，三姊妹分别在不同的角度看见臣身上有一个近似四叶草形状的胎记，跟小时侯听到的预言吻合，但菁为人优柔寡断没有主见，菁与茵因因此抛身而出，为制造机会给姐姐而不断奔走不久，三姊妹亦加入了沙滩排球队她们觉得的是，她们竟又在校内的垒学士方上发现四叶草胎记！三姊妹顿感迷闷，不知道吉卜赛女郎所言的真命天子究竟是谁.

programme.title: 食为奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天宝王祖蓝自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫胡诺言流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪万绮雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女厨神米小鱼何雁诗等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛黄智贤，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭林盛斌，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩张继聪策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗.

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地 Offliners, The
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融地产商业是贴地举动，富二代王子菲龚嘉欣饰却偏爱离地，与好友许正伟陈智燊饰开设初创科技公司一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希张振朗饰的厉害，邀他加入公司信希是一名离地毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱刘佩玥饰帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤李国麟饰弟王梓龙罗梓龙饰信希之妹丁信恩黄心颖饰身上！.

programme.title: 廉政行動2022 ICAC Investigators 2022
programme.desc: 十年前，唐偉聰袁偉豪飾與沈傲鳴譚俊彥飾同期加入廉署，兩人一起受訓，情同兄弟傲鳴因一次私自行動而受傷，未幾辭職，從此杳無音訊十年後，偉聰已晉升為總調查主任，並率領李進兒蔡思貝飾細粒陳曉華飾等下屬致力維護廉潔與公義偉聰於調查一宗懷疑銀行職員貪污案件時，發現傲鳴竟牽涉其中原來傲鳴憑其過往在廉署的調查經驗，助犯案集團多次避過各地刑事與反貪機構的偵查偉聰痛心好友忘記當年加入廉署捍衛公平公義的初心，誓要將犯案集團繩之於法！.

programme.desc: 凌丽荧李司棋与丈夫黄永正夏雨凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风黄宗泽更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟李国麟助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华关菊英及亲弟梁赞阮兆祥大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧米雪有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家王浩信与许家独生女许贝儿岑丽香相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱陈敏之与有妇之夫郑立安唐文龙的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文黄翠如关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴.

programme.title: 廉政行動2022 ICAC Investigators 2022
programme.desc: 十年前，唐偉聰袁偉豪飾與沈傲鳴譚俊彥飾同期加入廉署，兩人一起受訓，情同兄弟傲鳴因一次私自行動而受傷，未幾辭職，從此杳無音訊十年後，偉聰已晉升為總調查主任，並率領李進兒蔡思貝飾細粒陳曉華飾等下屬致力維護廉潔與公義偉聰於調查一宗懷疑銀行職員貪污案件時，發現傲鳴竟牽涉其中原來傲鳴憑其過往在廉署的調查經驗，助犯案集團多次避過各地刑事與反貪機構的偵查偉聰痛心好友忘記當年加入廉署捍衛公平公義的初心，誓要將犯案集團繩之於法！.

programme.title: 赤沙印记 四叶草.2 Sunshine Heartbeat
programme.desc: 沙滩上，少年十五二十时；他们抛汗， 他们随入情网叶菁杨婉仪叶蕙李思欣及叶茵陈自琦三姊妹小时侯 碰到一个古上贼女郎部容衢儿，女郎预言大家姐将在十八岁那年，遇见身上有四叶草胎记的真命天子转眼间三姊妹已长大，现在是清岚国际学校的中六生清岚沙滩排球队的队长干逸臣司徒瑞祈外表俊朗性格活泼，是校内的风头人物，很多女同学也为了他而加入沙滩排球队，犹如行星屋绕太阳一般一日，三姊妹分别在不同的角度看见臣身上有一个近似四叶草形状的胎记，跟小时侯听到的预言吻合，但菁为人优柔寡断没有主见，菁与茵因因此抛身而出，为制造机会给姐姐而不断奔走不久，三姊妹亦加入了沙滩排球队她们觉得的是，她们竟又在校内的垒学士方上发现四叶草胎记！三姊妹顿感迷闷，不知道吉卜赛女郎所言的真命天子究竟是谁.

programme.title: 食为奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天宝王祖蓝自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫胡诺言流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪万绮雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女厨神米小鱼何雁诗等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛黄智贤，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭林盛斌，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩张继聪策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

Anggara dan Aini merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang hidup bahagia. Namun, menjelang ulang tahun perkahwinan mereka, Aini disahkan menghidap penyakit otak yang menyebabkan dia kehilangan ingatan secara berperingkat sehingga tidak lagi mengenali suaminya sendiri. Dalam tempoh yang semakin singkat, Anggara berusaha mempertahankan cinta mereka sambil menemani Aini menghadapi detik-detik paling sukar dalam hidupnya. Selepas pemergian Aini, sebuah rakaman video yang ditinggalkannya mendedahkan rahsia yang mengubah kehidupan Anggara buat selama-lamanya.

programme.desc: Sepasang suami isteri, Dika Samuel Rizal dan Ranti Aliyah Faizah, tinggal di rumah baharu. Kekacauan dalam kehidupan pasangan itu mula muncul apabila Ranti mengandung dan anak yang dikandungnya adalah janin syaitan.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP1
programme.desc: Pengantara Saiful Azmi Jamsari berkongsi pengalaman semasa merakamkan beberapa episod Detik 12 Malam sebelum ini. Antaranya Episod 1 Musim 1 bertajuk Kisah Penggali Kubur. Beliau terlihat asap berkepul-kelul semasa menggali kubur semasa rakaman. Episod 2 Musim 2, Bertajuk Pemandu Kenderaan Jenazah. Pengantara memandu sendiri van tersebut dan dilihat kain meliput jenazah diterbalikkan. Episod 12 Musim1, Petugas Bilik Mayat. Pengantara berkongsi pengalaman apabila melihat kemunculan lembaga. Episod 9 Musim 2, bertajuk Muzium Perang. Pengantara ternampak patung dalam muzium perang tibatiba- tiba seakan-akan kepalanya bergerak. Episod 3 Musim 1, bertajuk Renjer Hutan. Beliau bertugas sebagai renjer hutan, diganggu oleh saka masyarakat orang asli. Pengantara melihat sendiri makhluk halus melalui kawasan tersebut

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Tayangan Perdana ini menampilkan babak pembukaan Bisikan Pontianak bersama rakaman eksklusif di sebalik tabir dan treler rasmi.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP1
programme.desc: Imbas kembali 12 tahun lalu di sebuah Kg Kuala Pari Hilir. Tiga kanak-kanak bersahabat iaitu Yeh Kumbang, Gani Gagap dan Li Kelubi perlu melintasi rumah Wan Peah selepas mengaji Quran. Wan Peah dikatakan seorang yang misteri, tinggal sendirian, mengamal ilmu hitam dan sering mengganggu kanak-kanak ini. Tok Hashim sebagai ketua kampung mempunyai seorang anak lelaki bernama Faan yang selalu bermain dengan Yeh, Gani dan Li. Suatu hari semasa bermain menyorok berhampiran dengan rumah Wan Peah, Faan dia telah dibawa lari oleh Wan Peah masuk ke rumahnya.

programme.title: Sweetpea EP6
programme.desc: Rhiannon mungkin terlepas begitu sahaja tetapi apa yang akan dia rugi dalam proses itu?

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP1
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Lisa dari sebuah NGO masuk ke kampung untuk membantu Bayu yang menjadi mangsa rogol. Insiden tersebut mengingatkan Lisa kejadian yang sama pernah berlaku kepadanya 7 tahun lalu di rogol oleh sekumpulan lelaki bertopeng. Bayu kemudiannya meninggal dunia. Mbah Ngai dibantu oleh Afifa membantu Siti anak Pak Samad yang sedang kemurungan. Afifa mengambil kesempatan, kononnya Siti terkena ilmu hitam. Pak Samad membayar sejumlah wang upahan kepada Afifa bagi membalas dendam perbuatan bomoh tersebut. Mbah Ngai menjaga Sarah anak kepada Afifa yang mengalami tekanan. Nasrun bersama kumpulannya membuat onak di kampong tersebut, mereka yang menculik Bayu dan membunuhnya. Kumpulan ini diketuai oleh Pak Samad. Manakala Afifa menggunakan ilmu hitam ke atas Mak Leha, emak kepada Bayu. Manakala Lisa bersama Syamil seorang bekas Inspektor meneruskan siasatan mereka bagi menangkap perogol Bayu.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP2
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Lisa bersama Syamil balik ke kampong untuk membantu Mak Leha menyiasat kejadian anaknya Bayu yang mati selepas dirogol. Mereka singgah di rumah Mbah Hira untuk berjumpa dengan Afifa dan Sarah. Syamil terpaksa meninggalkan mereka selepas di marahi oleh Afifa. Lisa berkongsi maklumat tentang kejadian rogol yang menimpa dirinya, Afifa, Sarah dan Bayu. Nasrun di ugut oleh Azhar, Caryl dan Bakri kerana cuba lari dari kumpulan mereka. Kumpulan perogol membuar perancangan untuk merogol cucu Pak Samad. Mbah Hari marahkan Afifa kerana menggunakan ilmu hitam ke atas Mak Leha, dia berusaha mengubati kaki Mak Leha. Sebaliknya, Afifa meminta sejumpalh wang dari Mak Leha kerana mereka mengubati kaki Mak Leha yang telah menjadi busuk.

programme.title: Hysteria! EP8
programme.desc: Kebenaran akhirnya terbongkar dalam kemuncak yang penuh kejutan dan akibat besar kepada semua.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP4
programme.desc: Kumpulan Hunter berjaya menangkap Siti semula, lalu merogolnya. Syamil menunjukkan gambar Nasrun kepadanya Lisa, dia memberitahu Afifa yang dia syak Nasrun dan rakan-rakannya adalah perogol mereka 7 tahun lalu. Afifa menggunakan ilmu hitamnya ke atas Nasrun, namun Mbah Ngai merampas peralatan tersebut. Imbas kembali 7 tahun lalu, Afifa, Sara dan Lisa diserang Kumpulan Hunter yang bertopeng, mereka menculik dan merogol mereka. Lisa keluar bersama Afifa ke rumah kosong lokasi mereka pernah di rogol. Tiba-tiba mereka ternampak Siti terbaring keseorangan. Pada tangan Siti terdapat segumpal rambut perogolnya. Mereka membawa Siti balik untuk berjumpa dengan Pak Samad yang kebetulan baru sampai. Lisa ternampak seutas jam di bilik Siti, kebetulan jam yang sama pernah di terima oleh Lisa satu masa lalu. Manakala Afifa menggunakan sihir ke atas pemilik rambut yang diambil dari tangan Siti. Bakri tiba-tiba muntah darah semasa meraikan kejayaan mereka bersama Caryl dan Azhar

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP15
programme.desc: Alia dan Susan tertangkap. Adam sempat meyelamatkan mereka yang hampir dibunuh Dr Zahir. Zacky turut terselamat manakala Dr Zahir ditahan polis. Ritz yang dalam tahanan lelaki bertopeng dipaksa memanggil Alia datang kelokasi mereka. Lelaki bertopeng memanggil Adam datang kelokasi yang sama. Zacky tiba dilokasi bersama Alia. Berlaku pertarungan antara Zacky dan lelaki bertopeng. Adam menembak kaki lelaki bertopeng untuk menyelamatkan Zacky. Dalam masa yang sama Alia dan Kai pergi menyelamatkan Ritz. Mereka semua terkejut apabila mendapati lelaki bertopeng itu sebenarnya Rafeeq yang juga adik kembar Adam. Mereka berdua bersaing dalam misi membalas dendam terhadap Tan Seri Jalaludin yang telah merampas harta dan membunuh ibu bapa mereka. Adam menembak Rafeeq sebelum menembak Tan Seri Jalaludin. Selepas kejadian Adam meminta Zacky menyerahkanya kepada pihak berkuasa

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya Diana Danielle membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya Remy Ishak kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP1
programme.desc: Aafiyah dan Rizq anak kepada pasangan Adelia dan Rafeeq. Aafiyah dimasukkan ke hospital, semasa abangnya menzirahi Aafiyah doktor mengesahkan gadis tersebut mengalami trauma dan lupa ingatan. Sebulan sebelum kejadian, Aafiyah menyambut harijadinya di sebuah hotel tempat ibunya bekerja. Disebabkan kesibukan bekerja, kedua-duanya meninggalkan Aafiyah keseorangan. Aafiyah ternampak seorang bertopeng membunuh seorang wanita, dia yang ketakutan cuba melarikan diri tetapi berjaya ditangkap oleh pembunuh tersebut. Aafiyah berjanji tidak akan membuka rahsia tersebut kepada sesiapa. Aafiyah bersama ibunya berjaya menyelamatkan berkereta keluar dari hotel. Namun pembunuh tersebut berjaya menahan mereka dan membunuh ibunya

programme.title: Nasi Tangas
programme.desc: Hairi dan Fatin adalah seorang kawan rapat. Mereka berdua bersama-sama membangunkan sebuah kafe yang dibuka bersama-sama. Hubungan mereka adalah seperti sepasang kekasih, tetapi Hairi dan Fatin tidak pernah lebih daripada seorang rakan. Mira juga rakan yang baik untuk Fatin. Mira mengakui bahawa dia jatuh cinta dengan Hairi.

programme.title: Ia Wujud
programme.desc: Sekumpulan remaja menceroboh masuk ke sebuah taman tema yang telah lama ditinggalkan. Berlatarbelakangkan zaman sebelum tersebarnya kisah-kisah seram dari kes Highland Tower, kumpulan ini percaya bahawa hantu tidak wujud. Lalu mereka mencabar satu sama lain untuk bermain permainan roh duit syiling di dalam taman tema terbiar itu.

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan yang suram, jurugambar forensik Adam berundur dari dunia, tinggal di rumah dan mengambil gambar jirannya sehingga dia diseret ke dalam penyiasatan lain oleh kawan baiknya, Detektif Man, yang meminta bantuannya untuk menyelesaikan siri pembunuhan ritual yang mengerikan. Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

programme.title: The Professionals
programme.desc: Dikhianati oleh rakan niaganya, Reza, Abi dipenjarakan. Keluar dari penjara, dia merekrut mangsa Reza, dan merancang untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: Midnight Show
programme.desc: Naya, Juna, Sarah dan seluruh pengunjung bioskop terlibat dalam misteri pembunuhan di sebuah bioskop tua pada tayangan tengah malam midnight. Pembunuhan terjadi saat bioskop sedang memutarkan film kontroversial tentang seorang anak umur 12 tahun yang membunuh dan memutilasi seluruh keluarganya.

programme.desc: Sasa mati dalam kemalangan tanpa menyedari kematiannya. Dua roh membantunya memahami keadaan dan menyelamatkan adik-beradiknya supaya dia dapat pergi dengan tenang.

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain Haji Zul Ariffin, ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian Nur Fazura, ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra Farid Kamil, yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie Izara Aishah dan Jiman Iedil Putra, Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.title: The Lift
programme.desc: Selepas sahabat baiknya hilang, seorang gadis kolej yang menghidap klaustrofobia mula menyiasat lif misteri tempat rakannya kali terakhir dilihat lif yang mungkin merupakan pintu ke dunia gelap yang menakutkan.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP9
programme.desc: Memaparkan Lisa marahkan Syamil yang datang ke rumah Mbah Nira untuk berjumpanya. Syamil syak kumpulan lelaki yang meminta pertolongannya adalah perogol. Afifa meminta Lisa menghapuskan SakaSara. Mbah Nira marahkan mereka, namun selepas diketahui Sara adalah mangsa rogol dia merelakannya. Azhar dan Cairyl berpindah tinggal di hotel selepas diganggu oleh lembaga misteri yang kononnya dihantar oleh Mbah Nira semasa mereka berada di rumah Bakri. Nasrun insaf dan bersedia membongkar rahsia Kumpulan Hunter yang merogol gadis penduduk di kampungnya. Nasrun berjumpa dengan Syamil, dia bersedia memberi bukti bagi membantu Syamil menangkap Azhar dan Caryl. Manakala Lisa dan Afifa lebih berminat untuk membalas dendam secara sihir sebelum pihak berkuasa menangkap perogol mereka.

programme.title: The Equalizer S4 EP2
programme.desc: Selepas seorang gadis muda dilanggar oleh kereta dalam perlumbaan jalanan haram, McCall menjejaki orang yang bertanggungjawab atas kemalangan dan lari itu. Dee merenungkan idea untuk mengikuti jejak langkah ibunya menyertai pasukan tentera.

programme.title: Sweetpea EP6
programme.desc: Rhiannon mungkin terlepas begitu sahaja tetapi apa yang akan dia rugi dalam proses itu?

programme.desc: Populariti program Uka-uka di televisyen membuat Shelly ingin menyertai ujian keberanian. Pasukan Uka-uka sedang menuju ke lokasi ujian keberanian terbaru Alas Moyang, yang terletak berhampiran dengan tempat tinggal Shelly.

programme.title: Sebelum Titik Noktah EP4
programme.desc: Hariz yakin Budi ada kena mengena kerana Budi ada masa dia bertengkar dengan Andy, Hariz tahu Budi adalah peminatnya, mungkin peminat ini bunuh mereka yang cuba sakiti Hariz.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati

Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces.

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to pass the level can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack, but luckily cyber security engineer Chun, manages to fend it off with his protective firewall system. To Chuns surprise, his boss is the mastermind of the attack, and when Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey.

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: The movie features three horror stories in different era: a pregnant woman haunted by a ghost sacrifices her life to save her baby a boy commits suicide after being bullied by four medical students and his spirit returns for revenge some company staff are haunted after they open a box of used clothes, releasing a more than 20-year resentment.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: I Did It My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive, complex world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and top-secret sting operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Xiao Xiao suffers from ADHD and faces bullying in school. Her mother sees her as a troublemaker, while her father toils abroad. The only solace comes from her empathetic teacher, Paul. During a typhoon, Xiao Xiao discovers a secret between her mother and Paul, unravelling complex emotions and shared helplessness in life.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate.

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer, Chen An vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: A charity gala turns deadly when the finance director is found dead and HK200 million in donations vanish. Lawyer Ma Ying Fung joins an inspector to uncover a web of money laundering and murder.

programme.title: Back to the Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with Nan since she met him once as a child. After graduating high school, Zhi realizes that she and Nan are in the same university, where they get to know each other by chance and become close friends. However, Zhi is still too shy to express her love for Nan. Will this long-term crush finally turn into true love?

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well Extended Version
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a washed-up stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. Due to his debts though, Red Hare may be taken away by the debtors. Master Luo has no choice but to seek help from his estranged daughter, and the incident ends up becoming a golden opportunity for them to reconcile.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Set in 2020 during the outbreak of COVID-19, the movie features interconnected stories of three womens lives as they navigate the uncertain future amongst their respective friends and families. From the struggles at home to challenges in relationships and conflicts at work, these three women rise with strength when faced with plights unknown.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Wing has been able to see ghosts since young. When his mothers suicide attempt forces him to return to Hong Kong and the home he ran away from, he discovers that the horrific visions that once haunted him have become worse. Caught between the living and the dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the Heartbroken Sword style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Back to the Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: Chao Yang and Zi Hong are soon to wed but both have not met the others parents. When a client requests for a livestream of their reunion dinner to promote his products, it set the stage for their parents first meeting. Estranged from his mother, Yang decides to rent a family for the dinner which results in a series of mishaps and hilarity.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk and Chief Inspector Lau both hit a dead end when investigating their respective bribery and money laundering cases. When Luk is accused of bribery after being framed by the money launderers, he risks everything he has to find crucial evidence against them to clear his name.

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional car racer, Le falls into despair after causing his brothers death in a car race, until he meets female doctor Hui and becomes an ambulance driver who vows to save lives with speed. Meanwhile, the truth about his brothers accident emerges with the investigation of Les three good friends...

programme.title: OMG! Moms Big News
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers shes unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Shadows Edge, The
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves pulls off a massive billion-dollar heist while outsmarting the Sky Eye surveillance system, shocking the city. To stop the criminals before they strike again, Macau police enlist retired surveillance expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild an elite tracking squad and hunt down the elusive mastermind behind the operation.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brothers death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh Glass Tears, Killer Clans and Shi Szu Lovers Destiny, who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they cant escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Taos real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Comedy Of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly Iron Fist technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her familys objection, so Hongs maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of Robin Hood meets The Sting. Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying whos done over 400 films as Tricky Ching, its the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. Its a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because peoples lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qis guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Woman Of The Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sisters death, but is shocked to discover that her fianc, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jins mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws lot in the final years of Hong Kongs greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu Mok Siu-chung is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit Wei Chiu-hua is killing swordsmen, hes in for more than he bargains for... Its an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword arent nearly enough!

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The films action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar The Lizard sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich mans party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chiefs granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her fathers towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her fathers debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Mersal
programme.desc: Maaran, is falsely arrested for the murder of his colleague, Dr Arjun Zachariah. He soon discovers that the real culprit is a lookalike who aims to expose corruption in the medical industry.

programme.title: Sarkarin Elam
programme.desc: A finance agent is conned by his love interest and travels to India to get his money back from her influential father, who is a Member of Parliament and industrialist.

programme.title: Arasangam
programme.desc: Arivarasu goes to Canada to search for his missing brother-in-law. However, he discovers a plot by terrorists to kill all intellectuals in India and stop the countrys growth.

programme.title: Hotspot 2 Much
programme.desc: An aspiring director presents three compelling stories that shed light on pressing social and ideological issues, sparking thought and meaningful conversations.

programme.title: Pattathu Yaanai
programme.desc: Saravanan and his friends come to Trichy to set up a new restaurant business. However, their plans get interrupted when he gets an order from a local gangster but falls for his girlfriend, Aishwarya.

programme.title: Game Changer
programme.desc: Ram Nandan, a government official, embarks on a relentless fight against corrupt politicians. Determined to bring about fair elections, he tries to revolutionise the way the government operates.

programme.title: Mazaka
programme.desc: Carefree friends Karthik, Rishi and Mani stumble into hilarious situations as friendship and romance complicate their lives.

programme.title: Nota
programme.desc: After a CM is charged with corruption, he is forced to pass the baton to his son. He with no political experience, finds himself stuck to the chair.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.
After mobiles start mysteriously flying out of the hands of people in Chennai, Dr Vaseegaran summons his trusted robot Chitti to ward off the bird-shaped supernatural powers of Pakshirajan.

programme.title: Yaamirukka Bayamey
programme.desc: Kiran, a telemarketer, renovates a mansion into a hotel with the help of Sharath. However, things take an unexpected turn when his customers die and Kiran realises that the hotel is haunted.

programme.title: Goli Soda
programme.desc: In Koyambedu market, four carefree coolie boys start a mess to earn respect and identity, transforming their lives and friendships along the way.

programme.title: Thirunaal
programme.desc: Blade, a henchman for a local gangster, Naaga, falls in love with Vidhya, the daughter of a factory owner. He has to choose between supporting her father and his boss, who are rivals.

programme.title: Kalathil Santhippom
programme.desc: Ashok and Anand, best friends despite their differences, face a problem when Ashok unintentionally causes a misunderstanding in Anands wedding. He then tries to fix it.

programme.title: Desingu Raja
programme.desc: Idhyakani falls for Bindu Madhavi despite their families rivalry. The lovers try to unite them, but their efforts lead to a conflict between the families.

programme.title: Guna 369
programme.desc: The life of Guna, a happy-go-lucky man, turns upside down when he is falsely framed for a murder and imprisoned. After his release, he sets off to hunt the real culprits and expose their crimes.

programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and accepted wisdom to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You wont find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of todays world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from Prove That Climate Change Exists to Who Will Win the Race to Space. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk Challenging perceptions.

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 香港中醫醫院今年12月11日起分階段開展24小時住院服務，並提供全面門診及專病治療市民擔心中西藥一起服用的問題，中醫醫院行政總監卞兆祥表示中醫醫院特意為中西藥相互作用設立一個內部的管理系統，列明哪些藥物跟中醫；或與西藥共用的時候可能有相互作用，或副作用等；這亦是中醫醫院首次正式在醫療系統有中西藥相互作用的系統卞兆祥指中西醫協作治療腫瘤，是中醫醫院的專病項目，他指有些癌症病人接受放射治療後，可能出現免疫系統問題胃腸系統消化系統神經系統等問題；會出現手腳麻痺肚瀉嘔吐脱髮等等，中醫醫院的中西醫專家可一起針對這些情況制定一個臨床的治療方案，發揮中西醫優勢12月11日起分階段開展24小時住院服務，重點在四個群組的人或有需要住院他指出第一類病人需要在醫院環境下配合檢查化驗多學科複雜的治療第二類是重症病人，或需要24小時監測，有醫護人員留意病人的基本情況第三種是有些病需要綜合治療，可能要針灸中藥西醫檢查化驗或物理治療等護理方面需要而住院另外，病人不能自理行動有困難等這四類病人需住院他續指有呑嚥困難語言方面有困難的病人不能單日間治療，還需要住院服務才能處理卞兆祥續指一些腫瘤病人做了放射化療後，身體很虛弱，不能走路，在中醫醫院用中西協作治療，給予病人多一個選擇卞兆祥表示會請一些全國名中醫來中醫醫院坐鎮，提高臨床診療水平院方已獲中醫藥管理委員會的支持，已辦了一些有限制註冊，讓國醫大師有了限制註冊後可以來中醫醫院看診，以減少病人到處求醫的困難卞兆祥續指國醫大師來港看診一次後，一些病人可透過遠程醫療做覆診；但至於有哪些國醫大師來中醫醫院助陣，卞透露有幾名國醫大師正在辦手續中，適時會公布他又指院方幾項重點專病是痛症婦科眼底病例如黃斑視網膜病糖尿病等都希望有專家以專門的治療方案跟中醫醫院的團隊一起結合治療，達到藥到病除至於北都大學城，中醫醫院在臨床科研方面在中西藥相互作用中醫的基礎理論研究臨床研究中成藥開發生育研究開發等，與本地大學內地大學海外大學一起合作，推動中醫科研工作

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 近日香港各區接連發生水管爆裂，有路段更在一個月內爆四次， 水務署要緊急停水維修，市民及商戶要撲水全港約有8400公里長的水管，水務署自2000年開始分階段更換老舊水管，有業界人士指出，約有50公里水管未能更換，成為隨時會爆裂的計時炸彈香港地下管線非常複雜，增加維修水管的難度，有區議員建議成立專責部門，統籌各類管線工程，加快換水管進度理工大學研發車載式探地雷達，掃瞄地底管道影像，配合管道機械人，進入水管找出滲漏位置，新科技可怎樣加快識別高風險的水管？ 遇上難關，有人會一蹶不振，但屢經挫折的關兆基反而以有限的資源，幫助更有需要的人五十二歲的他少年時經歷喪父被欺凌，大學畢業任職網絡安全顧問，卻遇上科網爆破而失業；轉行從事金融交易員，2008年又遇上金融風暴；後來自立一人公司從事代購業務，疫情時卻遇上捲款消失口罩供應商，損失近一百萬元幾乎一無所有的他，七年前卻選擇自購工具食材，推車仔走上街頭，免費為露宿者煮麵，用熱食送上關心他現時每星期五晚上都會開檔，近乎風雨不改，背後有甚麼原因？

programme.title: 我想身體健康

programme.title: 爆谷一周

programme.title: 東方驅魔實錄
programme.desc: 東方驅魔實錄攝製團隊實地紀錄香港驅魔師傅的兩次真實行動，近距離見證道士如何運用六壬神功符籙咒訣等古老秘法，助人脫困鏡頭之下，沒有劇本，只有最貼地的正邪交鋒同時，本特輯將淺談中華文化千年以來對鬼靈世界的獨特觀由陰陽平衡到輪迴報應，探討人們對死後的想像，進而了解東方驅魔背後的宇宙觀最後，我們不得不追問一個永恆的難題：驅魔，是否必要？究竟是鬼害人，還是人心自亂？驅魔，是在驅逐外在的邪祟，還是戰勝內在的恐懼與心魔？東方驅魔實錄不是恐怖片，而是一場結合文化信仰與現實的深度探索

programme.title: 모여라 딩동댕
programme.desc: 유아들이 일상생활 속에서 갖게 되는 흥미로운 궁금증과 호기심을 중심으로 다양하게 탐구해나가는 사고력 증진 프로그램입니다. 유아들의 눈높이에서 제기된 참신한 호기심 아이템을 선정하고, 선정된 아이템은 유아 스스로 추론하고 탐구할 수 있는 직접 체험과 다양한 활동 및 시청각 매체를 총동원하여 전개해나갑니다. 이러한 다양한 경험과 활동을 통해 유아들은 새로운 자극을 받게 되고 또 다른 도전감과 새로운 호기심으로 발전해나가면서, 창의적인 아이로 자라날 수 있을 것입니다. 사랑스러운 모야멍, 재미있는 웅이형, 친절한 동이언니, 그리고 우리의 친구 뚝딱딱 삼총사와 함께 호기심의 나라로 날아가볼까요?

programme.title: 국채금리 누르자 더 뛰는 비트코인, 금세계는 경제는
세상에서 가장 아름다운 여행
programme.desc: 장애나 희귀병으로 고통받는 아이들과, 가난 때문에 치료를 포기 해야만 하는 위기에 처한 가정을 찾아가, 전문의, 심리학자, 상담사, 건축설계사 등 국내 최고의 전문가 그룹이 장애를 앓고 있는 어린이와 그 가정의 회복을 목표로 전문적이고 구체적인 해결 방안을 제시해준다 치료와 재활을 적극적으로 도와주는 솔루션 프로그램.

programme.title: 국채금리 누르자 더 뛰는 비트코인, 금세계는 경제는
생활의 달인
programme.desc: 수십년간 한 분야에 종사하며 부단한 열정과 노력으로 달인의 경지에 이르게 된 사람들. 삶의 스토리와 리얼리티가 담겨 있는 생활 달인은 그 자체가 다큐멘터리. 비록 소박한 일이지만 평생을 통해 최고가 된 생활 달인의 놀라운 득도의 경지를 만나는 시간.

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 네모바지 스폰지밥
programme.desc: 어린이들 사이에서 최고의 인기를 자랑하고 있는 바닷속 네모난 친구는 누구일까요? 기상천외하고 유쾌하면서도 매력만점의 주인공 스폰지밥을 만나보세요! 저 깊은 태평양 바닷속, 비키니 씨티라는 해저도시에는 네모낳고 노란 해면동물 스폰지밥과 친구들이 있습니다. 스폰지밥은 애완동물인 달팽이 핑핑이와 함께 파인애플 집에 살고 있습니다. 스폰지밥의 장기는 정말 맛있는 음식을 척척 만들어 내는 멋쟁이 요리사라는 점과 언제나 모든 소동과 사건의 현장에 있다는 것입니다! 괴팍한 이웃 친구 징징이를 괴롭히는 것도 스폰지밥의 또다른 특기죠. 스폰지밥의 단짝 친구는 솔직하고 사랑스러운 불가사리 뚱이, 그리고 스릴만점의 모험을 즐기는 여자친구인 다람이입니다. 꿈과 환상의 도시인 비키니 시티 에서는 물고기 친구들이 걸어다니고, 게살버거가 가장 맛있는 음식은 이라고 하네요. 지금 바로 바닷속에 뛰어들어서 스폰지밥의 매력에 흠뻑 젖어보세요!

programme.desc: 귀신이 나오는 장소로 유명한 신비아파트, 그것도 444호에 이사 오게 된 하리네 가족. 첫날부터 그들은 자꾸만 이상한 일들에 휩싸이게 된다. 아무도 안 산다는 위층에선 밤새 쿵쿵거리는 소리가 울리고, 아파트 맨홀에서 기어 나온 괴상한 꼬마 아이는 자꾸만 내기를 하자며 하리에게 덤벼든다. 그러다 얼떨결에 꼬마 아이가 입에 달고 다니는 엿을 빼앗아 먹게 된 하리와 동생 두리. 그 이후부터 그들의 눈엔 하나둘 무서운 귀신의 모습이 보이기 시작하고, 정체를 알 수 없는 맨홀 꼬마는 귀신을 없애주면 원하는 소원은 뭐든지 이루어주겠다며 큰소리치는데...
